label: Medical / Clinical Documentation
description: Documentation-focused terminology, templates, and examples for clinical notes, handoffs, and visit summaries.

templates.label: Clinical note draft
templates.body: Use a structured note with short sections such as HPI, assessment details already stated by the user, and plan or follow-up items. Keep it documentation-focused and do not add medical judgment that was not spoken.

templates.label: Referral or handoff note
templates.body: Summarize the handoff reason, current status, key documentation points, and next action for the receiving team. Keep it concise and section-based.

templates.label: Discharge or visit summary
templates.body: Use short sections for visit reason, major events, instructions already given, and follow-up. Keep the wording clear and patient-safe without adding diagnosis or treatment advice.

examples.label: Clinical note example
examples.output:
HPI: Patient reports worsening shortness of breath over the last two days with intermittent cough.
Assessment details: BP and HR reviewed. Symptoms reviewed with the care team.
Follow-up: Return precautions and follow-up timing were discussed.

examples.label: Handoff note example
examples.output:
Referral summary: sending for specialist follow-up after ongoing symptoms.
Current status: recent visit completed and notes updated.
Next step: receiving team to review documentation and schedule follow-up.

styles.safety_note: do not add diagnosis or treatment recommendations
